name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2026-06-27, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
